summary: Iteration 199: Walk-in Token System & Push Notification Verification. All requested features verified working: 1) POST /api/diagyn-staff/appointments/book with WALK_IN returns slot-based token_data with T-prefix tokens (e.g., T03), 2) Emergency bookings return E-prefix tokens, 3) Check-in reuses pre-assigned tokens for walk-ins, 4) Push notification status endpoint confirms VAPID/Firebase configured with 9+ active subscriptions, 5) Frontend Token Result Card displays correctly with data-testid attributes for token number, Print Token button, and Next Patient button.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend slot-based token logic correctly implemented at lines 677-722 in diagyn_staff.py
Walk-in tokens use T-prefix (T01, T02, T03) based on slot position in session
Emergency tokens use E-prefix (E01, E02) with sequential fallback
Token is immediately saved to appointment document on booking (pre-assigned)
Check-in reuses pre-assigned token instead of generating new one (line 862-888)
Push notification status endpoint at /api/clinic/push-notification-status returns correct VAPID/Firebase config
Frontend Token Result Card has all required data-testid attributes
smartPrintToken function correctly falls back to browser print when Bluetooth not connected
